Name: Joja Corp Presents Can Hat
Author: Willcraftapple11
Description:
Unlocked after purchasing a membership with Joja, show your corporate pride with this Joja-Cola themed hat!
[i]Joja corp. not responsible for any sudden lice, dandruff, hair, skin, heavy metal poisoning, health issues or otherwise. If your hair suddenly changes color we are not at fault. On purchase of a Joja Brand hat or article of clothing you waive all right to pursue legal action due to use, or misuse, of said item.

[/i]Remember, Joja is a family! Life is better with Joja!™ Wear our hat and feel [i]Joja-tastic[/i]!

To unlock the hat:

[spoiler]Either:
- Buy the Joja Membership
- Complete the Community Center

OR:
Find the new Empty Soda Can item by fishing or digging around in your neighbor's trash; then tailor it in order to craft the hat![/spoiler]

COMPATIBILITY WITH BEARFAM:
When you have this mod and Bearfam installed you will be able to make and wear two new Joja Cola hats; one for the Peach Joja and one for the Pumpkin Joja. 

In order to get these wonderful hats you can either go to the Hat Mouse or tailor them with a piece of cloth and their respective cola.
